@SeaLightFound investigation in @Diplomat_APAC:

An essay contest for 🇵🇭Filipino public school children was actually a 🇨🇳Chinese Communist Party propaganda exercise in disguise — with 🇯🇵Japan and 🇹🇼Taiwan as the targets.

Our latest investigation reveals how Beijing's United Front Work Department used a Manila-based organization to funnel an anti-Japan essay competition into Philippine public schools — complete with cash prizes designed to drive participation across an under-resourced school system. The contest arrived on official Department of Education letterhead, giving it an air of legitimacy that concealed its true purpose.

As the article details: "Filipino minors received their prizes in the middle of someone else's political war."

The winning students were brought on stage at a United Front rally promoting China's "peaceful reunification" with Taiwan — turning their schoolwork into propaganda exhibits at a CCP political event. Foreign governments should not get a free pass to hide behind local civic groups as they recruit children into their information campaigns.
